blurb: Guests cruise on vessels through Muskoka's waterways, enjoying cottage scenery, architecture, and wildlife. The main sightseeing tour lasts 1 hour and 30 minutes. Private charters are available for events like weddings, corporate gatherings, and family reunions.
extraNote: Cruises run rain or shine · Smoking not allowed on vessels · Arrive 20 minutes prior to scheduled departure · Group reservations of 20+ adults receive 10% discount · Dock at 7 Lock Street East, Port Carling, on the side of the Port Carling lock, across from Muskoka's Ice Cream shop.
